name: Codex App Server
summary: Experimental JSON-RPC interface that powers rich Codex clients (e.g. the VS Code extension); embed Codex in your product. Replaces the removed codex mcp-server.
description: Started with `codex app-server` (WebSocket, Unix-socket and stdio transports); provides authentication, conversation history, approvals and streamed agent events. Open source under `codex-rs/app-server`. OpenAI notes it is experimental and not supported for production workloads; it is not an MCP server.
